prompt: What can a test of the code answer that a test of the data cannot?

choices.text: Whether the code is right, on inputs whose answer is known
choices.why: Right. A bug can pass every data test.

choices.text: Whether tonight's data arrived
Whether the warehouse is fast enough for the reports that read it every morning
Whether the publishers sent prices

prompt: Match each kind of test to what it runs on.

pairs.right: A fixture cut from real data

prompt: Why did the validator have to change before it could be unit-tested?

choices.text: pytest cannot import files with a hyphen
It needed a database
check() returned nothing, so the tests had no answer to look at
choices.why: It returned the reason or None.

choices.text: Its work ran at import, reading sys.argv
choices.why: Right. Now it is in main(), called only as a script.

prompt: Before the fix, what did the validator do with `list_price_cents: 104.9`?
hint: Not None, not a string, in range.

choices.text: Rejected it as missing, as it does with a null
Rounded it to 105
Accepted it as 104.9 cents
choices.why: Right. A hundredth of the price.

choices.text: Stopped the batch, as a broken export would
choices.why: One record cannot stop a batch.

prompt: How many unit tests of the validator passed on the first run?
What can a unit test do that no test on the data ever can?
hint: No publisher had sent one yet.

choices.text: Run every night
Try an input that has not arrived yet
Check the real prices that arrived from the publishers tonight

prompt: In a dbt unit test, what does `given` do?

choices.text: Lists the rows the model should return, in the columns named
Names the target
Inserts the rows into raw.orders for the length of the test
Replaces the model's input with the rows listed
choices.why: Right. The real tables are not touched.

prompt: Why include an order at 23:30 São Paulo time in the unit test?
hint: What day is it in UTC?

choices.text: It is already the next day in UTC, and must still be the 2nd
choices.why: Right. It tests the time zone rule.

choices.text: The shops close at 23:30
choices.why: Opening hours are not the point.

choices.text: dbt needs at least one row near midnight to accept a unit test as complete
choices.why: dbt needs nothing of the kind.

choices.text: Late orders are refunded more
choices.why: That has nothing to do with it.

choices.text: A test that hangs
A join between two models
A place where behaviour changes without changing the code

prompt: Why did the integration test hang?

choices.text: dbt crashed
The fixture was too large
PostgreSQL found a deadlock and stopped both of them before either finished
choices.why: It could not see it: one side was outside the database.

choices.text: The test's open transaction held a lock dbt was waiting for
choices.why: Right. And the test waited for dbt.

prompt: What does `autocommit=True` change for the test's connections?

choices.text: Each statement commits at once, holding no lock
choices.why: Right. Nothing is left idle in transaction.

choices.text: Writes are refused until the build has finished its swap
Queries run faster
dbt waits for the test to finish before taking any lock
